Fig. 1: Architecture of the overall pipeline. Videos are sent into Model M, which predicts masks and weak labels. Predicted masks are sent to an online video annotation platform, where a human annotator will fix the masks of each frame of the video, and a mask loss (fixed vs. predicted) is calculated and added to the weak loss, where fixed masks then become ground truth for the remainder of training.
